ownerWords: I see a theme - all of them are similar to each other and to the set-1 style I called merely easier on the eyes. None above 6 for this use case. I don't even immediately know what this IS - a seed shop, I gather. Layout okay in some, but in-use ease for the user is a constant weak theme across runs. Stop reusing the same design language; the loop should ASK the owner what theme and feeling is wanted before generating.
